title: WP-Cron Not Running
description: Fix missed scheduled posts, stale transients, and plugin tasks when WordPress cron stops firing reliably.

steps.title: Identify Missed Cron Symptoms
steps.instructions: Look for scheduled posts not publishing, backup plugins skipping runs, license checks failing, or 'missed schedule' on posts.

steps.title: Check DISABLE_WP_CRON and ALTERNATE_WP_CRON
steps.instructions: Review wp-config.php for define('DISABLE_WP_CRON', true) — valid only if real server cron is configured. Remove ALTERNATE_WP_CRON unless specifically needed.

steps.title: Inspect Scheduled Events
steps.instructions: Run wp cron event list and wp cron test. Look for duplicate hooks, far-future schedules, or orphaned events from deleted plugins.

steps.title: Set Up Real Server Cron
steps.instructions: Add a crontab entry: */5 * * * * curl -s https://example.com/wp-cron.php?doing_wp_cron or wp cron event run --due-now. Set DISABLE_WP_CRON true after verifying.

steps.title: Ensure wp-cron.php Is Not Blocked
steps.instructions: Security plugins, bot protection, and HTTP auth can block wp-cron.php. Whitelist the cron URL and server cron user-agent if needed.

steps.title: Clear Stuck Cron Locks
steps.instructions: Delete _transient_doing_cron from wp_options if a previous run crashed mid-execution. Avoid running overlapping long cron jobs.

steps.title: Verify Scheduled Tasks Execute
steps.instructions: Schedule a test post 5 minutes ahead or trigger a plugin cron manually. Confirm it runs on time and logs show successful completion.
